subject.title: Bug: sandbox.mode: "non-main" silently breaks sessions_spawn subagent initialization

question: Should sandboxed subagent startup failures keep returning accepted and then terminalize visibly, or should `sessions_spawn` preflight enough sandbox startup work to reject before returning accepted?
rationale: The choice affects the public asynchronous spawn contract, session/subagent state, gateway waits, and overlap with the broader lifecycle event work, so automation should not choose it alone.

options.title: Terminalize Async Startup Failure
options.body: Keep the accepted response contract and add a visible typed/logged terminal startup failure in session history, subagent list, and agent wait.

options.title: Preflight Sandbox Before Accept
options.body: Move enough sandbox startup validation before acceptance to fail fast, accepting extra spawn latency and compatibility review.

options.title: Defer To Lifecycle Contract
options.body: Resolve the broader lifecycle event surface first, then return to the sandbox-specific Docker startup proof path.

recommendation.title: Terminalize Async Startup Failure
recommendation.body: Keep the accepted response contract and add a visible typed/logged terminal startup failure in session history, subagent list, and agent wait.

likelyOwner.reason: The spawn contract and sandbox inheritance history make steipete the strongest available owner for the API/product choice.
